test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2025 - General Knowledge (Held On: 15th_September_2025_Shift_2)
subject: general
question:
Match the following Taekwon-Do Korean terms with their correct English meanings:

Which of the following is the correct pairing?

 
 

 Column A (Korean Term) 
 B (English Meaning)
 
 

 1. Tae
 A. Discipline or way
 
 

 2. Kwon
 B. To strike with the hand
 
 

 3. Do
 C. To strike with the feet
 
 

 4. Dojang Column
 D. Training Hall or place of practice
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2: 1-C, 2-B, 3-A, 4-D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Tae (1-C):** The Korean term "Tae" refers to striking or kicking with the feet, emphasizing the art of foot techniques in Taekwon-Do.
 
• **Kwon (2-B):** "Kwon" signifies striking or punching with the hand, highlighting hand techniques in the martial art.
 
• **Do (3-A):** "Do" translates to the "way" or "discipline," representing the philosophical and ethical aspects of Taekwon-Do.
 
• **Dojang (4-D):** "Dojang" refers to the training hall or place where martial arts practice is conducted.
 
• This pairing represents the fundamental terminologies of Taekwon-Do, a Korean martial art that combines self-defense techniques, discipline, and physical fitness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Key Terms in Taekwon-Do:**

 
 
• **Ki-Hap:** A loud yell or shout made during a technique to enhance focus and power. It is also used to intimidate the opponent.
 
• **Poomsae:** Patterns or forms practiced in Taekwon-Do that consist of a series of movements for training and self-defense.
 
• **Saju-Jirugi:** A fundamental exercise that involves executing punches in four different directions to develop basic skills.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context of Taekwon-Do:**
 
 
• Taekwon-Do originated in Korea in the 1940s and 1950s and was officially named by General Choi Hong Hi in 1955.
 
• The word "Taekwon-Do" is derived from three Korean words:
 
 
• **Tae:** Foot or kicking technique.
 
• **Kwon:** Hand or fist techniques like striking or punching.
 
• **Do:** The way or discipline, reflecting the philosophy behind the martial art.
